BrochureContent.Content:
Step into coastal elegance with this beautifully finished four-bedroom house set in the heart of the scenic Connemara landscape, on a large parcel of ground with sea frontage. Situated on the tranquil and picturesque Mynish Island, Carna, this stunning home offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and high-end finishes, while enjoying uninterrupted views of the Atlantic Ocean. Mynish Beach is a short walk from the house, offering a sense of serenity that few locations can match. This property sits on a large parcel of land, with direct sea frontage onto the Atlantic Ocean.

Every room in this residence is finished to an exceptional standard, blending timeless charm with contemporary living. Accommodation comprises of a welcoming porch and entrance hall. On the ground floor there is a spacious sitting room with open fire. The kitchen and dining room is contained within a bright open floor plan, and there is a separate sunroom with double doors leading outside. Off the kitchen there is a convenient separate utility room. There are two well-appointed bedrooms on the ground floor, one of which is ensuite. The primary bathroom, with bath, is also on the ground floor. Upstairs there are two more large bedrooms, both ensuite and one of has a large walk-in wardrobe. Great care to detail has been taken throughout this home, which has a total floor area of circa 212 square meters.

This energy efficient property has a BER rating of B2 and is serviced by an on-site septic tank and oil fired central heating.

The house sits on an attractive, well-maintained site, with beautiful views in every direction. Mynish Island is a hidden gem off the west coast of Ireland, known for its sweeping sea views, rugged natural beauty, and peaceful atmosphere. Just a short drive from Carna Village, this property is conveniently located to local shops
